verdict.rationale: mParticle documents its own rule-like automation on incoming event data. Users define audience criteria and connect the audience to an output, where qualifying users are activated automatically. Forwarding rules can also conditionally block event forwarding based on consent state. There is no documentation of a general rules engine that fires arbitrary actions on specific events. Missing for 10: a documented event-triggered rule/action builder, real-time trigger semantics, a range of action types beyond audience activation and forwarding filters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Once you have created an audience, you must connect it to an audience output where you can activate it.
Applying a forwarding rule of: Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present.
Score likelihood to churn, convert, or grow in value, then activate audiences before risk or opportunity passes.
